Video-Based Registered Behavior Technician (RBT) Training

Elevate your team’s skills and performance with our comprehensive and interactive RBT training program.

Request A Demo

Flexible Learning, Proven Results: RBT Video Training On-the-Go

Our video-driven RBT training aligns with the certification guidelines issued by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB). These interactive courses require active responding throughout each module and provide organizational leaders with immediate, real-time access to performance metrics. Modules can be completed wherever and whenever is most convenient.

Demonstrate Competency

Within every module, quizzes are thoughtfully integrated to strengthen memory retention and offer administrators measurable outcomes.

Ace the Final Assessment

Have confidence your staff will be prepared for the BACB exam with Rethink's pass rate of over 80%.

Continuing Education

With access to live webinars and on-demand content, training doesn't need to end with the final exam. Keep your staff current on research and trends in the field with Rethink Resources.

Key Benefits and Features

Empower Your Staff to Stay Ahead

Dive into our expansive RBT curriculum, offering over 40 hours of high-quality, on-demand video training. Your staff will not only stay updated but will also gain a deeper understanding of best practices, ethics, and methodologies in behavior analysis.

RBT Training Excellence

Rethink’s video-based RBT training is designed to meet and exceed the certification criteria set forth by the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB). We are committed to delivering an educational experience that not only educates but also instills confidence.

Real-Time Monitoring and Performance Insights

Our state-of-the-art interactive platform provides administrators with real-time access to performance dashboards. Track learner progress, identify gaps in knowledge, and customize training paths to align with individual and organizational goals.

Flexibility at Your Fingertips

With our platform, you can choose to include our training as part of a structured onboarding process or allow your staff to complete modules on their own time – from the comfort of their home, during work breaks, or even while commuting. Our program is accessible via multiple devices, giving your staff the freedom to learn anytime, anywhere.

Embedded Quizzes for Enhanced Learning Retention

Quizzes are strategically integrated into each training module to ensure not just theoretical knowledge but also its practical application. These quizzes serve as an effective tool for reinforcing learning and offering administrators quantifiable data to measure staff competence.

Final Competency Exam for Mastery Assurance

After the completion of all modules, learners must undergo a comprehensive final competency exam. This test ensures that each participant has gained a thorough mastery of the essential RBT coursework, equipping them to be effective and certified Registered Behavior Technicians.

Monthly Webinars and Interactive Sessions

Become a part of our ever-growing learning community that goes beyond the initial training. Our monthly webinars offer valuable insights into the latest trends, topics, and research in behavior analysis. These interactive sessions serve as a continuous learning forum, where your team can exchange experiences and share best practices.

Access to Exclusive Resources and Tools

As a member of our learning community, you will gain exclusive access to resources designed to support your ongoing education and professional growth. From research and case studies to downloadable templates and toolkits, we provide you with the assets you need to excel in your practice. This additional layer of support empowers you and your team to continually improve and stay ahead in the rapidly evolving field of behavior analysis.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I Purchase the Course Individually Online?

Our RBT training program is exclusively offered to ABA therapy practices and organizations for the purpose of training their staff teams. It is not available for individual purchase.

Who is Eligible to Become a Registered Behavior Technician?

Our RBT training is aimed at professionals who seek to understand and apply evidence-based Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) techniques. To qualify, you must be at least 18 years of age and have completed high school or its equivalent.

What Should I Do if I Have Additional Questions About RBT Certification?

For questions that extend beyond the scope of this FAQ, we recommend reaching out directly to the Behavior Analyst Certification Board. Visit BACB’s Contact Us Page for more information.

What Topics Are Covered in the Training?

Our comprehensive training addresses a wide range of subjects, including but not limited to Data Measurement, Assessment, Skill Acquisition, Behavior Reduction, and Professional Conduct. We cover all tasks and subtasks listed in the RBT Task List, as well as ethical guidelines pertinent to behavior technicians.

What is the Duration of the Training Program?

Our program delivers at least 40 hours of training content that can be accessed and completed at your own pace via any device with Internet connectivity.

Is Live Instruction Included in the 40-Hour Training?

The 40-hour training is fully online and does not include live instruction. Additional live competency training will be overseen by your supervising BCBA as part of the Competency Assessment.
